# Function isFunctionTool

  * isFunctionTool(obj: unknown): obj is [FunctionTool](../classes/FunctionTool.html)<undefined>

Type guard to check if an object is an instance of BaseTool.

#### Parameters

    * obj: unknown

The object to check.

#### Returns obj is [FunctionTool](../classes/FunctionTool.html)<undefined>

True if the object is an instance of BaseTool, false otherwise.
